info.longName: iShares U.S. Broker-Dealers & Securities Exchanges ETF

funds_data.description: The index measures the performance of the investment services sector of the U.S. equity market, as defined by SPDJI. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
